skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and scope of government intervention in a market economy.
Understand the four basic roles of government: resource allocation, income redistribution, macroeconomic stability, and national representation on international forums.
Understand the limitations of government intervention in a market economy.
Understand the research object, content, and methods of public economics.
Analyze different types of market failures and the role of government intervention.
Understand the benefits of public choice and compare principles of public choice within a direct democratic mechanism.
Systematically understand various policy tools used by the government to intervene in the market economy.
Develop skills to explain and analyze government intervention policies in Vietnam's socialist-oriented market economy.
Develop self-learning and research skills to accumulate knowledge and adapt to changing work environments.
Develop ethical awareness and professional responsibility in participating in the formulation, monitoring, and evaluation of government intervention policies.
